Manischewitz Potato Knishes (Frozen)

Ingredients:
1 frozen Manischewitz potato knish

Instructions:
1. Preheat the oven to 375°F.
2. Place the frozen knish on a baking sheet.
3. Bake 20-25 minutes, until the crust is golden and the filling is heated through.
4. Rest a few minutes before eating.
note: Store-bought frozen staple, 1 serving = 1 knish. Directions are standard bake-from-frozen; Yidi will send package photos when home — put 'Confirm exact directions from package' in the recipe notes. Kosher: pareve. Category: Main. Tags: frozen, store-bought, lunch, staple.
